architecture: HMM (50%) + PIT Market Breadth (50%) -> Composite 0-100 -> BULL/SIDEWAYS/BEAR -> strategy mode + position size. Distribution Days removed from production (research-only, default off).
summary: The final two-engine system (HMM + PIT Market Breadth, no Distribution Days in production) passes all six validation priorities. State alignment is mechanically verified (0 violations across 628 walk-forward windows), the two engines are strongly orthogonal (Pearson 0.483), regime conditioning shows monotonic information value (BULL +29.7 bps/day vs BEAR -6.8 bps/day), PIT ablation improves every variant, walk-forward has no catastrophic year, and parameter robustness is smooth. Distribution Days is retained only as archived research code.

evidence.state_alignment: OK — 0/628 violations; BULL-state mean ret always > BEAR-state; label-monotonic

documented_limitations: PIT breadth OHLCV coverage ~83.4% (16.6% of historical members unresolvable via free data: BK, ANSS, ATVI, CERN, FB-as-renamed, etc.) — accepted as documented research limitation per spec §3, not a blocker.

HMM re-engages slowly after crashes (2020/2022/2023 recoveries): bull probability stays low for weeks into a new bull market. This is a deliberate stability tradeoff of the two-engine system; the human-in-the-loop reviews daily signals.

Bearish Breadth Divergence has known false-alarm episodes (e.g. 2024-Q3 warning fired 96 trading days early, opportunity cost +11.46%). The rule is retained per spec §6 (structural rule); its behavior is documented and should be watched in live operation.
GitHub constituent data is crowdsourced: cross-validated against thuningxu (Jaccard 0.9995) but individual change dates can be off by days.
The regime engine is NOT a standalone alpha strategy — it is an exposure-sizing / regime-awareness overlay for a buy-and-hold portfolio + human-in-the-loop swing bot (spec §9).
recommendation: PASS — production-ready as a regime-awareness and exposure-sizing overlay. Keep Distribution Days disabled in production (default). Maintain the human review step (<=1hr/day) as the final decision gate.
